name: lenexa-city-center-commons tiles

geofence.label: Lenexa City Center — the approx. 200-acre core around 87th St Pkwy & Renner Blvd plus the adjacent City Center blocks that hold the anchor tiles. Working boundary, drawn by hand; corrections welcome by pull request.

notice: Tiles are keyed by address or place id only. There is no owner, landlord, or management field in this data model, by canon. `tags` drives the lens filters and is empty until notes carry them. `external` holds third-party fields a human accepted from a sweep proposal; every rendered value is attributed and carries a deep link back to its source.
